title: Where Member Relief Is Taken Off an Expedited Charge
content:
# Counter Card: Where Member Relief Is Taken Off an Expedited Charge

On a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service the relief a member is allowed is taken off one part of what is charged or off both, according to whether a member benefit has been drawn on the membership held with the Belrose Circle Membership Programme in the twelve months to the handling date.

| The membership records show | Where the relief is taken off |
|---|---|
| The membership stands active and a member benefit has been drawn in the twelve months to the handling date | off the expedited charge and the out-of-hours charge together |
| The membership stands active and no member benefit has been drawn in that window | off the out-of-hours charge alone |
| Any other case | neither of these two ways of taking the relief off applies |

**In words.** Where the membership stands active and a member benefit has been drawn in the twelve months to the handling date, the relief is taken off the expedited charge and the out-of-hours charge together. Where the membership stands active and no member benefit has been drawn in that window, the relief is taken off the out-of-hours charge alone. In any other case neither of those two ways applies.

**Worked on hypothetical inputs.** Take an expedited charge of 400.00 USD, an out-of-hours charge of 100.00 USD and relief of 20 percent.

- Where a member benefit has been drawn in the window, the relief is taken off the two together: 500.00 USD less 20 percent of it, 400.00 USD.
- Where no member benefit has been drawn in that window, the relief is taken off the out-of-hours charge alone: the out-of-hours charge falls to 80.00 USD, and with the expedited charge of 400.00 USD the two come to 480.00 USD.
